clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's anxiety rose as she lay awake over money in March 1988, and she and your father stopped talking with each other about money by May 1988; your brother's grades fell in November 1989, four months after the death; your mother's anxiety then fell again in March 1990 once she returned to work. The shifts in money worry and distance between your parents begin before the death, but the pile of shifts—in your mother, your father, and your brother—clusters around these months, and your mother's return to work in March 1990 is where it settles.
